items.html: *And behold, the difference that there is between the Mochin of the time of pregnancy and the Mochin of the time of nursing has been explained, namely, that in the Mochin of pregnancy there were only two Mochin, Hochma and Bina, while the Daat was not at all recognizable in him then. But in the nursing there are three Mochin, for the Mochin of Daat also began to be recognizable in him, only in an inclusive manner alone.
